key_points: U.S. Bancorp raised its quarterly dividend by 3.9%, extending its streak of dividend increases.
Zacks highlighted higher rates and industry tailwinds, with decent loan demand for regional banks.
The bank announced expansion of its nationwide middle market banking team to accelerate growth.
Floating rate series remained highlighted as attractive, likely benefiting from higher rates.
Headlines are mostly generic or noise; no major earnings, guidance, regulatory, legal, M&A, or product developments were reported.
